codes.description: Sepsis due to Escherichia coli [E. coli]
Urinary tract infection, site not specified
Unspecified Escherichia coli [E. coli] as the cause of diseases classified elsewhere
Type 2 diabetes mellitus with diabetic chronic kidney disease
Hypertensive chronic kidney disease with stage 1 through stage 4 chronic kidney disease, or unspecified chronic kidney disease
Long term (current) use of oral hypoglycemic drugs

reason: Key uncertainties: (1) E11.22/I12.9 not documented by provider - diabetes with CKD or hypertensive CKD cannot be assumed; AKI is acute, no CKD documented, so these should likely be removed and replaced with E11.9 or E11.65 plus I10. (2) E11.65 hyperglycemia: glucose 248 but 'hyperglycemia' not documented by provider, so E11.65 may be unsupported, use E11.9. (3) E87.20 lactic acidosis: provider documented lactic acidosis in H&P as organ dysfunction, acceptable but E87.20 vs E87.29 should be verified for FY2027 code set. (4) Dehydration/volume depletion documented in H&P; E86.0 acceptable. (5) Pyelonephritis was only 'likely early' and not carried to discharge, so N39.0 retained. (6) Z79.84 long-term oral hypoglycemic use reasonable, insulin inpatient only. Recommend coder review of diabetes/hypertension code assignment.
